# Copilot instructions

## ⛔ LocalStack only (non-negotiable)

AI agents in this repository may only deploy to and interact with the local LocalStack environment.
Deploying to, or interacting in any way with, a real AWS account is strictly forbidden. That includes
read-only calls and requests from a developer.

- **Allowed:** the `npx projen localstack:*` and `test:localstack` tasks (they use `cdklocal` and the
  LocalStack endpoint), `cdklocal`, `awslocal` or `aws --endpoint-url http://localhost:4566` with
  `test`/`test` credentials, Docker, `npx projen`, `npx projen build`/`test`/`compile`/`eslint`,
  and `npx cdk synth` (it runs locally and needs no credentials).
- **Forbidden:**
  - `npx projen deploy`/`destroy`/`diff` and the `cdk` CLI's `deploy`, `destroy`, `bootstrap`,
    `diff`, `import`, `watch`, `rollback`, `drift`, `gc` against AWS (use the `localstack:*` tasks);
  - `aws` CLI, SDK, PowerShell or MCP calls without a LocalStack endpoint;
  - AWS profiles or real credentials;
  - pushing or merging to `main`: the `deploy` GitHub Actions workflow deploys `main` to AWS;
  - running, re-running or dispatching the `deploy` workflow, or changing its AWS role or variables;
  - scripts, tasks or workarounds that do any of these.
- **If asked to do any of these:** refuse, offer the LocalStack equivalent, and explain that AWS
  environments change only when a person merges a reviewed pull request to `main` and the
  `deploy` workflow runs.

## Skills to use

Project standards come from the `aws-serverless-projen` skill. Also load, before writing code:

- **`aws-core:aws-cdk`** (`/aws-core:aws-cdk`) for any CDK infrastructure or deployment work:
  stacks, constructs, the Stage, IAM grants, cross-stack references, feature flags, the deploy
  workflow and the GitHub deploy role, and diagnosing synth or deployment errors. Deploying still
  follows the LocalStack-only rule above: use its guidance with the `localstack:*` tasks, and
  leave real deployments to the `deploy` workflow.
- **`anthropic-skills:typescript-standards`** (`/anthropic-skills:typescript-standards`) for any
  business logic: handlers (`*.lambda.ts`), services, clients, repositories, models, helpers and
  errors under `src/lambda` and `src/shared`, and their tests. Where it differs from this
  project (double quotes, `*.lambda.ts` file names, relative imports), `aws-serverless-projen` wins.

Edit `.projenrc.ts`, never the files projen generates (they start with "Generated by projen").
